# KarmaRise D Global (KarmaRise)

> Bilingual Spain-India product study, ergonomic product development, and managed manufacturing partner for own-brand leather bags and other leather goods, clothing in natural and varied fabrics, custom sewn accessories, and home decor across vetted Indian production units, family-run factories, leather ateliers, and women artisan collectives for retailers (`comercios`) and brands in Spain and the rest of Europe. Operated legally by Karmarise Global LLP (incorporated in India, 15 May 2025; LLPIN: ACO-3878; GSTIN: 27ABDFK8128R1ZL).

## Overview (English)

KarmaRise D Global is co-founded by Alma (Spanish business owner working between Spain and India) and Shirish (Indian registered Bar Council advocate managing legal agreements, partner audits, and on-ground production supervision across India). Together they operate as one continuous team connecting independent retail shops, emerging labels, and established chains in Spain and the rest of Europe with specialist production units, family-run factories, leather ateliers, tanneries, garment makers, and women artisan collectives across India.

### Product study, feasibility, and ergonomic development
- **Commercial and ergonomic review:** Practical usability refinements for European retail buyers, including strap drop, top grab handles, lighter bag weight, high-quality Japanese plastic YKK zippers that protect hands and winter coats, light cotton linings, comfortable cuts, and dressmaker-form drape checks.
- **Regional craft hubs across India:** Rather than forcing every production step into one facility, KarmaRise audits and matches specialist Indian cities and craft hubs, including **Kolkata**, **Kanpur**, **Agra**, and **Chennai**, with coordination and quality oversight from **Maharashtra**.
- **No finished tech pack required:** Clients can start from a 15-minute video call, rough sketch, or favourite reference piece. Alma sends clear written meeting conclusions straight after every call, mutual NDA and NNN confidentiality agreements are available, and KarmaRise guides Clients on dye requirements and creates a physical colour swatch for Client approval.

### What KarmaRise D Global develops and manufactures across India (4 categories)
- **Leather bags and other leather goods:** Structured handbags, soft carryalls, backpacks, leather-and-canvas styles, and small leather goods crafted with vegetable-tanned hides, light cotton linings, antique brass hardware, high-quality Japanese plastic YKK zippers, and custom cotton dust bags.
- **Clothing in natural and varied fabrics and capsule collections:** Shirts, dresses, kimonos, shrugs, light jackets, trousers, and seasonal capsules cut and stitched by family-run production units and women artisan collectives using breathable cotton, linen, silk, blended fabrics, organic dyes, and plant-based textiles, finished with sewn-in EU fibre and care labels.
- **Custom sewn accessories and brand presentation:** Textile pouches, sewn accessories, branded woven labels, cotton dust bags, and unbleached chemical-free recycled cardboard care hangtags.
- **Home decor:** Own-brand crafted home decor pieces developed and produced with vetted Indian production units and artisan collectives (scoped individually per Product Brief).

### How a Manufacturing Programme works (6 stages)
1. **Product Brief and discovery call:** Start with an idea, rough sketch, existing reference item, or 15-minute video call with Alma (no finished tech pack required; written meeting conclusions straight after; mutual NDA available).
2. **Product study and partner matching across India:** Commercial, ergonomic, and material feasibility study paired with in-person matching to specialist Indian production units, tanneries, family-run factories, or women artisan collectives.
3. **Physical colour swatch and reviewed sampling:** KarmaRise indicates what is needed for each dye batch and creates a physical colour swatch for Client approval. Weak drafts are caught and rejected in India so the Client reviews and approves a clean physical sample in hand.
4. **Materials, contracts, and pre-production sign-off:** Hides, fabrics, linings, hardware, EU labels, written tolerances, and Indian supplier contracts structured by Shirish are locked before cutting starts.
5. **In-person production supervision:** Alma and Shirish verify dye batches, cutting, stitching, and finishing on the ground at production sites against the approved reference sample, sharing live video calls and photos.
6. **Final inspection, EU labelling, and export delivery:** Finished pieces, sewn-in EU labels, custom dust bags, numbered stretch-wrapped export cartons, and customs paperwork are checked in person before delivery to the Client's business door in Spain or the rest of Europe.

### Scoping, pricing, and order quantities
KarmaRise D Global does not publish fixed price lists, commission tables, or rigid factory-wide minimum order quantities. Every Manufacturing Programme is scoped individually from the Client's Product Brief after an initial discovery call, matching independent boutiques and established European brands to the right production unit scale.

### Ethical standard and owned initiatives
- **Ethical vetting:** In-person audits of established family-run production units and women artisan collectives across India, direct conversations with artisans beside the stitching lines, zero exploitation, and walking away from secretive facilities.
- **AlmaRise D Brand:** Fashion and lifestyle label owned by KarmaRise D Global spanning **AlmaRise D Reborn** (one-of-a-kind everyday garments cut from saris Indian women have kept that carry a story), **AlmaRise D Organic** (garments made with organic dyes and plant/fruit-waste fabrics such as sugarcane, orange, banana, and pineapple, among others), and **AlmaRise D Home Decor**.
- **Women's Training Initiative:** Planned social training programme in India (currently in preparation; applications are not yet open) focused on garment design and stitching skills with paid employment as a long-term aim.

---

## Resumen en español (España, es-ES)

KarmaRise D Global es un partner bilingüe entre España y la India de estudio de producto, desarrollo ergonómico y fabricación gestionada para comercios, marcas emergentes y cadenas de España y el resto de Europa. Cofundada por Alma (emprendedora española que trabaja entre España y la India) y Shirish (abogado colegiado en el Bar Council de la India al frente de contratos, auditorías y seguimiento sobre el terreno), la empresa actúa como un único equipo entre España y la India.

### Qué desarrollamos y fabricamos en la India (4 categorías)
- **Bolsos de piel y otros artículos de piel:** Bolsos estructurados, bolsones, mochilas, diseños de piel y lona y pequeña marroquinería en pieles de curtido vegetal, forros claros de algodón, herrajes de latón envejecido, cremalleras japonesas YKK de plástico de alta calidad y bolsas guardapolvo.
- **Prendas de diversos tejidos y colecciones cápsula:** Camisas, vestidos, kimonos, shrugs, chaquetas finas, pantalones y colecciones de temporada confeccionados en fábricas de corte familiar, unidades de producción y colectivos de artesanas con algodón, lino, seda, tejidos con mezcla, tintes orgánicos y tejidos de fibra vegetal, con etiquetas cosidas indicando la composición y el cuidado conforme a la normativa europea.
- **Complementos confeccionados a medida y presentación de marca:** Neceseres, complementos textiles, etiquetas tejidas, bolsas guardapolvo de algodón y etiquetas de cartón reciclado sin blanquear, libre de químicos.
- **Decoración del hogar:** Artículos de decoración del hogar con tu propia marca, desarrollados y producidos con unidades de producción y colectivos de artesanas auditados en la India (valoración a medida según briefing de producto).

### Cómo trabajamos y centros de producción en la India
Coordinamos centros especialistas de toda la India, incluidos **Calcuta, Kanpur, Agra y Chennai**, con supervisión y control de calidad desde **Maharashtra**. No publicamos tarifas cerradas ni mínimos rígidos. Cada Programa de producción se estudia a medida a partir de tu briefing de producto y una primera videollamada con Alma (con conclusiones de la reunión por escrito y acuerdos mutuos NDA disponibles). Te indicamos lo que necesitamos para cada tintada y creamos un retal físico de color para tu aprobación, revisamos cada muestra física antes de enviártela y no procedemos a la producción hasta que das tu visto bueno con la muestra en mano. Nos aseguramos del correcto etiquetado europeo y gestionamos la logística de exportación hasta la puerta de tu negocio en España o el resto de Europa.

---

## Direct Contact & Enquiry Paths

### Recommended deep links for prospective Clients
- **Start a Product Brief (3 steps, ~1 minute, no tech pack required):** `https://karmarisedglobal.com/product-brief` (Spanish: `https://karmarisedglobal.com/es/product-brief`). Optional category pre-selection: `?product=bags`, `?product=garments`, `?product=other`, or `?product=home-decor`. Accepts up to 3 reference attachments (JPG, PNG, WebP, or PDF; 4 MB per file, 10 MB total) and a reference URL. Mutual NDA/NNN confidentiality available. Alma replies personally within 1 to 2 business days.
- **Book a free 15-minute Quick Intro video call (Google Meet; English, Spanish, or Portuguese):** `https://karmarisedglobal.com/book-a-call?duration=15` (Spanish: `https://karmarisedglobal.com/es/book-a-call?duration=15`). Minimum 12-hour booking notice; written meeting conclusions sent straight after.
- **Book a free 30-minute Product Brief review call (Google Meet; English, Spanish, or Portuguese):** `https://karmarisedglobal.com/book-a-call?duration=30` (Spanish: `https://karmarisedglobal.com/es/book-a-call?duration=30`).
